children: The telecom company adds legal and financial expertise to its board as both appointments await shareholder approval

Vodafone Idea has appointed legal professional Gopika Pant as an Additional Director, qualifying as an Independent Woman Director, for a five year term starting September 17, 2026. The appointment was approved by the board on September 14 and is subject to shareholder approval.

Pant brings more than four decades of legal experience and is the founder of Indian Law Partners. She is qualified in India and admitted to the New York Bar, with experience spanning corporate and commercial law, cross border transactions, mergers and acquisitions and corporate restructuring.

The company is also seeking shareholder approval for the appointment of Anil Berera as an Independent Director. Berera joined the board for a five year term effective August 31, 2026. Vodafone Idea has initiated a postal ballot process covering both appointments.
